detail.title: Emergence of Responsibility and Accountability in Autonomous Agents
detail.summary: Responsibility in autonomous agents is operationalized not through internal intent, but through auditable constraint frameworks. Resilience in control systems depends on treating communication and interaction quality as active control constraints rather than implicit assumptions, bridging the gap between engineering behavior and ethical accountability.
detail.reason: Incorporating resilience and control constraints into the governance model for responsibility.
